Based on how many requests batched in the Generation API call, those many `jobStepResponses` will be returned.

Each one contains `documentMetadata` object with an `id`. This document corresponds to the response for each of the request in the batch. Use `documentMetadata.id` as `documentId` while making subsequent call to fetch the generated content.
